description: This file provides a data service module for a mechanic portal, handling local storage, and integration with Supabase for user authentication, request management, and profile handling.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the necessary environment variables for Supabase are set.

methods.name: getMechanicStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the mechanic application status, either from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: registerMechanic
methods.description: Registers a new mechanic user, either via Supabase or locally in mock mode.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either via Supabase or locally.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user, from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listUnassignedRequests
methods.description: Lists requests that are not yet assigned, from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: listMyAssignments
methods.description: Lists requests assigned to a mechanic, from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: getRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a specific request by ID, from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: acceptRequest
methods.description: Assigns a request to a mechanic and updates its status, via Supabase or locally.

methods.name: updateRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a request, with optional notes, via Supabase or locally.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates a user's profile information, via Supabase or locally.
